query: Help me understand the key points in this table — what should I concentrate on?

per_column.name: staff_interaction_quality
per_column.rationale: A genuine categorical axis (friendly/rude/indifferent/mixed) that adds qualitative nuance beyond the numeric Staff Service rating and helps surface a key theme. However, groundedness is compromised: in the row about dreadful seats/headphones the text says nothing about crew, yet the column asserts 'unhelpful_indifferent'. The near-total absence of NULLs (only 20) signals values are being forced onto rows where staff is not mentioned, i.e. inferred from overall tone rather than read from source.

per_column.name: food_quality_assessment
per_column.rationale: Useful thematic decomposition with a nice granular value ('dietary_request_failed') and correct use of NULL for silent rows (e.g. the 'consistently good service' review is left null). But the seat/headphone review that never mentions food is coded 'poor_bland', an invented negative. Grounded where food is discussed, hallucinated where it is not.

per_column.name: service_consistency_trend
per_column.rationale: Detecting 'declining_vs_past' / 'improving' is a legitimately interesting axis for spotting eroding service, so it adds leverage. Weakness is that ~70% collapse to the catch-all 'first_time_no_baseline', which is a reasonable default when the text gives no comparative signal (as in the samples), so it is not a hallucination but the column's analytical bite is limited to the minority of comparative reviews.

per_column.name: cabin_product_type
per_column.rationale: Product-level granularity (lieflat vs recliner business, qsuite, premium economy) is a good grouping axis that goes beyond the raw Class column. Groundedness is uneven: the 1h45 Jakarta-Singapore review that only mentions legroom/IFE is labelled 'new_business_lieflat', an unsupported specific, while the economy 3-3-3 review is correctly 'standard_economy'. Some values appear inferred beyond what the text supports.

per_column.name: disruption_handling_quality
per_column.rationale: Captures how delays/cancellations were handled, a high-value concentration point (2321 'inadequate_poor'). Correctly uses 'not_applicable' for the many reviews with no disruption, matching all five samples where no disruption is mentioned. Sound grounding.

per_column.name: ground_service_experience
per_column.rationale: Separates check-in/boarding sentiment from inflight, a distinct and useful axis. Appropriately NULL for the silent sample rows. Values look like sound readings of source text where present.

per_column.name: customer_service_resolution
per_column.rationale: Complaint-resolution outcome is analytically relevant, though it partially overlaps in spirit with disruption_handling and booking_policy. Uses 'no_complaint' default sensibly; the samples (no complaints raised) are correctly coded. Well grounded.

per_column.name: booking_policy_issue
per_column.rationale: Enumerates concrete policy pain points (rebooking, refunds denied, lost seat reservations) — a useful axis for operational focus. Default 'no_issue' is applied correctly to the samples, including the emergency-exit-seat review which mentions booking but no policy dispute. Grounded.

per_column.name: haul_type
per_column.rationale: A clean, high-leverage grouping dimension deterministically derivable from Route. All five samples (Jakarta-Singapore short, Singapore-London long, etc.) are classified correctly. Strong on both dimensions.

judge.rationale: Collectively the added columns form a rich thematic decomposition of the free-text reviews (staff, food, ground service, disruption handling, complaint resolution, booking issues, cabin product, haul type), directly serving the 'what should I concentrate on' query by giving multiple genuine axes to group and compare on that go beyond the existing numeric ratings. Usefulness is solid overall. Groundedness is generally good — the complaint/handling/ground/booking columns correctly use 'not_applicable'/NULL for silent rows, and haul_type is deterministically routable — but there is a recurring hallucination pattern in the more subjective columns: a review mentioning only seats/entertainment was assigned negative staff ('unhelpful_indifferent') and negative food ('poor_bland'), and a short domestic hop was labelled 'new_business_lieflat'. These forced/over-specified values, plus the near-zero NULL count in staff_interaction_quality, pull the table-level groundedness down from otherwise strong.
